CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  AGENDA
  REGULAR MEETING
  111 South First Street
  City Hall Conference Room C – 2nd Floor
  October 13, 2026
  7:00 p.m.

CALL MEETING TO ORDER:

ROLL CALL:

NORA CORONA, Chairman
ANKIT UDANI, Vice Chairman
MICHAEL DANINGER
STANLEY TSAI
JENNIFER NG
STEVE KUCHENSKI, Secretary

CONSENT AGENDA:

All items listed on the Consent Agenda are considered by the Design Review Board to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion unless a citizen or Board Member requests otherwise; in which case, the
item will be removed for separate consideration. Items placed on the Consent Agenda include smaller
scale projects with no or minor design issues and ministerial matters.

1.  MINUTES – September 22, 2026

  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted the action
  minutes of the September 22, 2026, Regular Meeting of the Design Review Board.

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

2.  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-163
  1881 West Main Street
  Applicant: Steve Therriault

  This is an application for three (3) new walls signs on an existing 2-story commercial building
  for the existing tenant known as “East West Bank.”

  Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is approved without conditions.

  1
 3.  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-147
  1658 West Valley Boulevard
  Applicant: Christina Yu

  This is an application for a new Master Sign Program consisting of seven (7) building signs and
  various directional signs for an existing medical office building. The proposed Master Sign
  Program includes two (2) building identification wall signs, five (5) tenant identification signs
  mounted to an existing canopy, and various non-illuminated directional signs.

  Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is approved without conditions.

4.  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-041
  126 South Cordova Street
  Applicant: Ricky Yiu Chao

  This is an application for the demolition and replacement of the existing front covered porch for
  an existing single-family residence. The project was previously continued by the Design Review
  Board at their regular meeting on August 11, 2026.

  Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is approved without conditions.

5.  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-26-059
  123 North Valencia Street
  Applicant: Joanna Lee

  This is an application for exterior alterations to an existing single-family residence, including the
  removal and replacement of three (3) existing windows and removal of the rear sliding door to
  be replaced with one (1) new window.

  Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is approved without conditions.

6.  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-168
  1036 Geranio Drive
  Applicant: Andy Yu

  This is an application for a new 640 SF addition to the rear of an existing 1,177 SF single-family
  residence, including a 49 SF rear porch.

  Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is approved without conditions.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS (TIME LIMIT – 5 MINUTES):

Citizens wishing to address the Alhambra Design Review Board on any matter within the subject matter
jurisdiction of the Alhambra Design Review Board not on the Agenda may do so at this time. Please
STATE YOUR NAME AND ADDRESS CLEARLY for the record.

Please note that while the Alhambra Design Review Board values your comments, pursuant to January
1, 1987, amendments of the Brown Act, the Board cannot respond nor take any action until such time as
the matter may appear as an item on a forthcoming agenda.

  2
 ADJOURNMENT:

The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Alhambra Design Review Board will be held on October
27, 2026, at 7:00 p.m., in Alhambra City Hall Conference Room C – 2nd Floor, 111 South First Street,
Alhambra, California.

  NOTICE:

AGENDA ITEMS: Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of
business described hereinabove are on file in the offices of the Community Development Department in
City Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, California, and are available for public inspection during regular
office hours, which are 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a
question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, he or she may
contact the Community Development Director either in person at the Department offices, or by telephone
at (626) 570-5034 during regular office hours.

AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT: If you require special assistance to participate in any City
meeting (including assisted listening devices) please contact the Community Development Department at
(626) 570-5034. Notification of at least 72 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make
reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to this meeting.

APPEALS: Any person wishing to appeal any decision of the Design Review Board to the Planning
Commission may do so by filing an appeal in writing along with the appropriate appeal fee to the
Community Development Department in City Hall within 10 business days of the Design Review Board
decision. The appeal period for items on this agenda expires at the close of business on October 29, 2026.

  AGENDA REPORT
  October 13, 2026
  Design Review Board DRB-25-163

TO:  City of Alhambra Design Review Board

FROM:  Steve Kuchenski, City Architect
  By: Eric Martinez, City Architect Representative

SUBJECT:  Design Review Board DRB-25-163

APPLICATION SUMMARY:

1.  Location:  1881 West Main Street

2.  Applicant:  Steve Therriault

3.  Property Owner:  Jonathan Wu

4.  Designer:  Signtech Electrical Advertising

5.  Project Type:  New Wall Signage

6.  Zoning:  AC – Automotive Commercial

7.  Staff Recommendation:  Approval

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:

This is an application for three (3) new walls signs on an existing 2-story commercial building for
the existing tenant known as “East West Bank.” The proposed east and west signs will consist of
front-lit channel letters and logo, which will feature white acrylic faces with vinyl overlays, ¾-inch
trim caps, and 3-inch aluminum returns. The proposed south sign will also consist of front-lit
channel letters and logo; however, the logo will feature a white Lexan face with a 1¾-inch trim.
The west and south signs will be vertically centered along their respective building façades, while
the east sign will be vertically aligned with an existing window opening. All proposed signage will
be horizontally centered within the corresponding building openings and roof elements.

STAFF RECOMMENDED ACTION:

Staff recommends Design Review Board to:
  •  APPROVE. The proposed project is approved without conditions.

           AGENDA ITEM NO. 3

  AGENDA REPORT
  October 13, 2026
  Design Review Board DRB-24-147

TO:  City of Alhambra Design Review Board

FROM:  Steve Kuchenski, City Architect
  By: Eric Martinez, City Architect Representative

SUBJECT:  Design Review Board DRB-24-147

APPLICATION SUMMARY:

1.  Location:  1658 West Valley Boulevard

2.  Applicant:  Christina Yu

3.  Property Owner:  Stephanie Chung

4.  Designer:  New Sign Solution, Inc.

5.  Project Type:  New Master Sign Program

6.  Zoning:  CMU – Commercial Mixed Use

7.  Staff Recommendation:  Approval

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:

This is an application for a new Master Sign Program consisting of seven (7) building signs and
various directional signs for an existing medical office building. The proposed Master Sign
Program includes two (2) building identification wall signs, five (5) tenant identification signs
mounted to an existing canopy, and various non-illuminated directional signs. The two (2) building
identification wall signs will feature back-lit channel letters and logo with an acrylic backer,
stainless steel faces, and 2-inch returns. The wall signs will be installed with ½-inch stand-offs
from the finished face of the wall. Each wall sign will be vertically centered between the edge of
the façade and the adjacent building openings. The five (5) proposed tenant identification signs
will feature front-lit, trimless channel letters with an aluminum backer, 3-inch returns, and 4-inch-
tall aluminum raceways that the signs will sit on. The proposed raceways will be painted to match
the existing metal canopy structure. The tenant signage will be horizontally centered within the
existing canopy areas. The acrylic faces for the tenant signage will be provided in either red, blue,
or white, as indicated on the plans. The proposed directional signage will consist of a combination
of painted signs, aluminum cabinet signs wrapped around a light pole, and 3-inch-thick adhesive-
mounted wall signs.

STAFF RECOMMENDED ACTION:

Staff recommends Design Review Board to:
  •  APPROVE. The proposed project is approved without conditions.

APPLICATION SUMMARY:

1.  Location:  126 South Cordova Street

2.  Applicant:  Ricky Yiu Chao

3.  Property Owner:  Ricky Yiu Chao

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:

This is an application for the demolition and replacement of the existing front covered porch for
an existing single-family residence. The project was previously continued by the Design Review
Board at their regular meeting on August 11, 2026. At the meeting, the Board provided the
applicant with recommendations for further refinement of the project, including: (1) The applicant
should continue to refine and study the proposed front porch design, incorporating the
considerations and recommendations verbally expressed by the Design Review Board during its
discussion of this agenda item.

In response to DRB comments, the applicant has modified the proposed design. The proposed
128 SF covered porch will consist of two (2) tapered square columns with smooth concrete column
caps, exposed beam and rafter roof framing with square cut rafter tails, and a simple wood railing
design spanning between the piers. The proposed materials include a river rock stone veneer
finish on the columns from grade to column cap, white paint for exposed wood framing, and
asphalt shingle roofing to match the existing house. The wood railing components will receive a
white painted finish to complement the trim and framing colors.

Staff recommends Design Review Board to:

SUBJECT:  Design Review Board DRB-25-168

APPLICATION SUMMARY:

1.  Location:  1036 Geranio Drive

2.  Applicant:  Andy Yu

3.  Property Owner:  Albert Liu

4.  Designer:  AP Design

5.  Project Type:  New 1-story Rear Addition to Existing SFR

6.  Zoning:  RL – Residential Low Density

7.  Staff Recommendation:  Approval

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:

This is an application for a new 640 SF addition to the rear of an existing 1,177 SF single-family
residence, including a 49 SF rear porch. The proposed addition will consist of new stucco exterior
walls, lap siding at the underside of the gables, windows, an asphalt shingle roof, attic vents, and
a porch landing with supporting post. The addition will feature a gable roof designed with a slope
and overall height similar to those of the existing residence. A new gable roof is also proposed
over the rear porch. The porch will include a new concrete landing and steps, along with a
decorative square post consistent with the architectural character of the existing Ranch-style
residence. The rear gables will incorporate square attic vents and lap siding at the underside of
the gables, matching the front of the residence. The proposed exterior materials and color palette,
including the proposed vinyl windows, will be selected to match the existing main residence. The
project also proposes the installation of one new wall-mounted sconce at the rear porch.

STAFF RECOMMENDED ACTION:

Staff recommends Design Review Board to:
  •  APPROVE. The proposed project is approved without conditions.
